sources.TypeTextStubApi: public interface TypeTextStubApi { String apply(String value, List<String> values, TypeTextAnchor anchor, TypeTextFlag__mdt flag); }

cases.question: Stub rendering and generated stub type name
cases.source: @IsTest private class TypeTextR001 { @IsTest static void observed() { TypeTextStubProvider provider = new TypeTextStubProvider(); TypeTextStubApi stub = (TypeTextStubApi)Test.createStub(TypeTextStubApi.class, provider); String value = String.valueOf(stub); System.assert(false, 'P|R001|' + String.valueOf(value)); } }

cases.question: Stub provider type and provider fields
cases.source: @IsTest private class TypeTextR002 { @IsTest static void observed() { TypeTextStubProvider provider = new TypeTextStubProvider(); TypeTextStubApi stub = (TypeTextStubApi)Test.createStub(TypeTextStubApi.class, provider); String value = String.valueOf(provider) + '|providerFlag=' + String.valueOf(provider.providerFlag) + '|providerName=' + provider.providerName; System.assert(false, 'P|R002|' + String.valueOf(value)); } }

cases.question: Generic method parameter Type tokens seen by StubProvider
cases.source: @IsTest private class TypeTextR003 { @IsTest static void observed() { TypeTextStubProvider provider = new TypeTextStubProvider(); TypeTextStubApi stub = (TypeTextStubApi)Test.createStub(TypeTextStubApi.class, provider); stub.apply('x', new List<String>{'y'}, new TypeTextAnchor(), null); String value = String.join(TypeTextStubProvider.observedTypes, '|'); System.assert(false, 'P|R003|' + String.valueOf(value)); } }

cases.question: Generic Type tokens from class literals and Type.forName
cases.source: @IsTest private class TypeTextR004 { @IsTest static void observed() { String value = TypeTextSupport.typeName(String.class) + '|' + TypeTextSupport.typeName(Type.forName('String')) + '|' + TypeTextSupport.typeName(List<String>.class) + '|' + TypeTextSupport.typeName(Type.forName('List<String>')) + '|' + TypeTextSupport.typeName(TypeTextAnchor.class) + '|' + TypeTextSupport.typeName(Type.forName('TypeTextAnchor')); System.assert(false, 'P|R004|' + String.valueOf(value)); } }

cases.question: Failed cast to an owned class
cases.source: @IsTest private class TypeTextR005 { @IsTest static void observed() { Object source = 'x'; String value; try { TypeTextAnchor result = (TypeTextAnchor)source; value = 'NO_ERROR'; } catch (Exception e) { value = e.getTypeName() + '|' + e.getMessage(); } System.assert(false, 'P|R005|' + String.valueOf(value)); } }

cases.question: Global describe keys matching an owned unprefixed name
cases.source: @IsTest private class TypeTextR008 { @IsTest static void observed() { Map<String, Schema.SObjectType> allTypes = Schema.getGlobalDescribe(); List<String> keys = new List<String>(); for (String key : allTypes.keySet()) if (key.toLowerCase().contains('typetextitem')) keys.add(key); keys.sort(); String value = String.join(keys, '|'); System.assert(false, 'P|R008|' + String.valueOf(value)); } }
